Tevez completes his transition from Juventus to his life's love: Boca Juniors. 'Very Grateful' to Juve.

Tevez finally leaves Juve ahead of time. He was always known to miss his homeplace and Boca Juniors. Was chosen best player in Brazil (go figure) while he played for Corinthians. Was astounding in England too. Then he shone in Italy (Juventus), and finally was only too eager to return to his beloved Buenos Aires and Boca Juniors.

May he keep shining.
Was it for money? Or did he want to honestly go back?

Nah. He'll be earning less. He honestly wanted to go back to Boca. He never let down his old poor neighbourhood (nicknamed "Fuerte Apache" / "Apache Fort") and its people. He was very often seen celebrating a goal of his own by lifting a bit his team's t-shirt and showing something like this.
Oh wow. Then its good he went back!

Yes, people are glad he's back. I just hope he fares well and scores a lot (just not that much against Argentinos Juniors, please!).

As the economy here is not as strong as in Europe, the usual thing is players coming back after they have no more chances in the big European leagues, or even in smaller ones yet still more profitable than coming back to Argentina.
Tevez's case is just so different. While already 31 y.o., he still had a year going on for him in Juve, still strong and fast as a 27 y.o. player, and he was highly valued by the team and very esteemed by the fans there. Today he'll be officially presented at Boca Juniors, and (I think) next match he'll play for them.

While I enjoyed all his Brazilian and European career, I especially enjoyed his times at West Ham.
